title: mcMails
description: A messaging/mailing system to send messages to offline players.
body:
# 📬 mcMails

The perfect offline-messaging/mailing system for your minecraft server. Whenever a player is offline and you want to notify them, just use this plugin and send your message. Configure message formats with different chat colors and hex codes to make messages engaging with custom prefix support. Store chat data with SQLite.

## 🛠️ Commands:

1. /mail {player} {message} : Send a message to a player who is offline.
2. /block {player} : Block a player to stop receiving messages from them.
3. /mcmails reload : Reload the plugin to apply changes you made to file without requiring to restart your server.

## 💡 Features:

1. Database - Message / Data management.
2. Custom Messages - Configure your messages to make them look amazing.
3. Blocking System - Block annyoing players if you're a server owner.
